light_entities.label: Light(s)
light_entities.description: The Home Assistant light entities this group should drive. Pulled live from Home Assistant - if a light is already set up there (any brand/integration), it's selectable here, no extra setup needed.

color_mode.label: Mode
color_mode.description: 'Auto' picks between Smooth/Ambient/Energetic/Flashing on its own based on how energetic the music currently sounds, instead of staying on one fixed mode for the whole track. 'Strobe' is a hard on/off toggle, not a dim/brighten - see its own warning below.

brightness.label: Brightness
brightness.description: The ceiling this group renders up to, as a percent.

beat_multiplier.label: Speed
beat_multiplier.description: Pulses per beat. 1x follows the track's real tempo exactly. 2x/4x insert evenly-spaced pulses between beats (softer than the real beat) for a faster feel - how crisp these look in practice depends on your lights' own response time.

transition_style.label: Transition style
transition_style.description: 'Fade' eases between colors/brightness smoothly. 'Instant' snaps to a hard, un-eased change on every update instead - a punchier, more percussive feel, at the cost of visible stepping during the non-beat color drift most modes also do.

sensitivity.label: Sensitivity
sensitivity.description: Amplifies the detected audio signal itself, as a percent - distinct from Speed (which only changes how often pulses fire, not how strong they look). Raise this if quieter listening volumes make the lights look washed-out/barely reactive; 100% is unmodified.

hue_lock_enabled.label: Lock color
hue_lock_enabled.description: Keep the lights on one fixed color (set via 'Locked color' below) regardless of beat/treble-driven color changes - only brightness and saturation keep reacting to the music. For matching a room's decor or a specific color rather than roaming the color wheel.

hue_lock_deg.label: Locked color (hue degrees)
hue_lock_deg.description: Only used when 'Lock color' above is on. 0=red, 60=yellow, 120=green, 180=cyan, 240=blue, 300=magenta.

restore_on_stop.label: Restore lights when music stops
restore_on_stop.description: When the music stops, put each light back exactly how it was just before syncing started (on/off, brightness, color) instead of leaving it frozen at whatever the last beat happened to render.

user.title: Choose your lights
user.description: Pick which Home Assistant light entities this group should drive. Any light already set up in Home Assistant, of any brand, is selectable here.

manifest.description: Sync any Home Assistant light to music in real time, using the visualizer pipeline (the same beat/spectrum feed Hue Lights Sync uses) and Home Assistant's own light.turn_on service - works with any light HA already controls (Kasa, Hue, LIFX, Zigbee, whatever), with zero extra setup beyond picking the entities.
